sentences.imageNotes: 公車站旁，主角媽媽提醒主角小女孩往後站，女孩正從靠近路緣的位置退回媽媽身旁。公車已到站旁，正在低速靠站，車身清楚可見。呈現公車來了，因此先退後等車停穩。女孩留在人行道上，不跨入車道，也不與公車貼得太近。不畫成衝撞、驚險逃跑或已登車。不放站牌文字、路線號碼、廣告、品牌或可讀車牌。
sentences.imagePrompt: Single square 1:1 preschool educational picture-book illustration. Supplied reference sheet: row1 all L058 STYLE ONLY, row2 refined examples, row3 family and teacher identity anchors. Closely preserve fine pencil-and-watercolor lines, warm natural sunlight, bright rich nuanced color, detailed clean environment, soft natural faces, stable preschool proportions. No readable text, letters, numbers, brands, watermarks, logos or captions anywhere. Reject generic simple cartoon, thin Japanese watercolor, anime, 3D and photorealism. Fixed protagonist girl, preschool age, short dark bob, pink hairclip, pink cardigan, navy skirt, pink shoes, correct family-anchor proportions. Fixed mother: dark shoulder-length hair, cream cardigan and blue skirt, warm adult face. Fixed father: short dark hair, blue shirt, tan trousers. Preserve family identities from bottom-row references. Bus stop on broad sidewalk in Taiwan. Mother gently gestures for girl to step BACK away from curb toward mother. Girl clearly taking a calm backward step, still fully on sidewalk with ample safe distance. Large plain city bus has arrived and is slowly pulling alongside curb on ROAD, not sidewalk. Bus is prominent with no markings or route display. Both remain well away from its path. Clear arrival-and-step-back story, not boarding, not danger or running. Empty/plain bus shelter, no readable sign, advertisement or plate.
sentences.imageReuseDecision: New scene: prior L356/L358 bus scenes show seating/queue/stopped bus, not girl stepping back with mother on arrival.
